scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c red,yellow "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
